description: Somos un equipo apasionado por la ciencia, la tecnología y la exploración espacial. Nuestra misión es devolverle vida a las historias de las misiones espaciales que dejaron huella en la Luna, Marte y el espacio profundo, rescatando el legado de los equipos que permanecen allí. A través de la innovación, la creatividad y herramientas tecnológicas, buscamos transformar estos vestigios en experiencias educativas e interactivas que inspiren a las nuevas generaciones a descubrir el universo.
summary:
Our project consists of creating a digital children's storybook titled Spirit and Opportunity: The Last Hope, which tells the story of the two twin rovers sent by NASA to Mars. Through an adventure full of discoveries, challenges, and perseverance, we share how Spirit and Opportunity explored the Red Planet, helped find evidence of water on its surface in the past, and far exceeded their expected mission lifespans.

We chose the illustrated storybook format, aimed at children in middle childhood, to transform complex historical and scientific information into a simple, exciting, and educational narrative. The book was designed using Canva and is available in digital format, aiming to provide free access to children, students, and space enthusiasts.

We believe this project is important because it brings space exploration closer to younger generations, sparks their scientific curiosity, and shows that even though these explorers can no longer communicate with Earth, their discoveries and contributions to humanity will never be forgotten.
details:
Our project is an illustrated digital storybook titled Spirit and Opportunity: The Last Hope, created to bring the story of the Spirit and Opportunity rovers closer to children in middle childhood and spark their interest in space exploration and science.

The storybook works as a visual and narrative reading experience that tells the mission of these two robotic explorers on Mars: from their launch and arrival on the Red Planet to their significant discoveries, the challenges they faced, and the end of their communications with Earth. Through characters, illustrations, and an adventure-filled story, we transform historical and scientific information into content that is easy to understand, entertaining, and educational.

Its main benefits include learning about Mars exploration, promoting science communication, strengthening curiosity and imagination, and discovering the legacy of two devices that significantly contributed to our understanding of the Red Planet. Our expected impact is to inspire younger generations, encourage their interest in science, and demonstrate that scientific discoveries remain valuable even after a mission comes to an end.

To develop the project, we used Canva as our design and editing tool, where we organized the narrative and designed the storybook in digital format. We chose this format to facilitate distribution and provide free access to children, students, teachers, and space enthusiasts. We did not use hardware or programming languages, since our proposal focuses on science communication through digital storytelling.

The creativity of our project lies in transforming a real space exploration story into a children's storybook, using storytelling as a bridge between science and imagination. Instead of presenting only technical facts, we give Spirit and Opportunity the leading roles, portraying their challenges, discoveries, and perseverance as part of an adventure.

Throughout its development, our team primarily considered the target audience's age, language clarity, the accuracy of historical and scientific events, visual appeal, accessibility, and the educational value of the story. Our goal is to create a resource that not only informs but also moves and inspires readers, allowing future generations to remember these explorers who, although they remained on Mars, will never be forgotten.
dataRefs: Mars Exploration Rovers: Spirit and Opportunity
